# Recommended GitHub repository settings

These public metadata fields affect GitHub search and link previews but cannot be
configured from repository files. Apply them under **Settings > General**.

## Description

```text
Self-hosted AI agent workspace with tool calling, multi-model routing, MCP, multimodal files, and multi-agent workflows for Web, Windows, and macOS.
```

## Topics

```text
ai-agent
self-hosted
multi-agent
llm
mcp
tool-calling
model-router
workflow-automation
electron
vue
nodejs
openai-compatible
dashscope
multimodal
noobot
```

Remove broad or ambiguous topics such as `smart` and `bot` after applying the
more specific search terms above.

## Social preview

Upload a 1280 x 640 PNG that contains the Noobot name and the short phrase
"Self-hosted AI agent workspace". Avoid screenshots containing real sessions,
user names, provider configuration, or API credentials.

## Measurement

Record these figures once per week from **Insights > Traffic**:

- Repository views and unique visitors
- Git clones and unique cloners
- Referring sites
- Popular content
- Latest Release asset downloads

Compare four-week windows after changing repository metadata. Public GitHub API
statistics do not expose views, clones, referrers, or popular-content data.
